product_metadata.title: InterDesign Zia Rustproof Aluminum Shower Caddy - Bathroom Storage Shelves for Shampoo, Conditioner and Soap, Ocean
features: NO RUST: Caddy is stainless steel and ocean plastic baskets add visibility.
EXTRA SPACE: 2 storage baskets, hooks and towel bar – holds shampoo, conditioner and accessories.
DRAIN & POUR: Plastic storage shelves have round cutouts for drainage and storing bottles top down.
FIRM GRIP: Non-slip shower head clip secures storage caddy in place. Measures 9.5" x 4.5" x 22.5".
THE INTERDESIGN PROMISE: We put our expertise to work for you turning even the simplest must-have into an elegant accessory.
description: This storage organizer caddy features a contemporary design and naturally rust resistant construction to add long lasting beauty to your shower stall A great way to store all your bathing essentials, the shower caddy utilizes unused wall space in the shower, transforming it into convenient storage shelves Clean and simple, the caddy has a naturally rust resistant aluminum frame and 2 clear plastic baskets, so you can easily see the contents The deep top basket accommodates shampoo and conditioner bottles, holding them upside down in the circular cutouts for easy pouring The shallow lower shelf is ideal for bar soap and smaller accessories, and features plastic razor clips At the base of the caddy is a handy towel rack for drying washcloths, and 2 hooks hang loofas, sponges and more Installing in seconds, the organizer caddy simply hangs over the shower head with a non-slip grip to instantly provide beautiful and functional bathroom storage shelves InterDesign’s creative products enhance your décor, turning simple home solutions into must-have accessories that shine Designed in the USA, we are proud to produce a wide selection of high quality home, bath and storage solutions that excite, inspire and charm Stylish, functional and affordable, our products have been enriching customers’ homes for over 40 years
